cases.caption: Two people stretch a bungee cord, extending it to its maximum length.
observations: The severe orange-body fragmentation and curved/chaotic connection structures seen in A250 are absent at the four sampled A400 times. This is a real visible stability improvement in these frames.

The A400 main suspended structure, rope arrangement and upper-left figure remain almost unchanged across the selected times; the requested two-person extension to maximum length is not visibly demonstrated.
R1-400 has larger changes in people/rope configurations, including a right-side figure at later sampled times; these changes alone do not establish correctly executed bungee stretching.
cases.interpretation: Both artifact reduction and weak requested-process execution must be reported. Do not count less visible change by itself as better physical correctness.
